title: Futures: contracts, ticks, margin and expiry
summary: What a futures contract is, how tick size, tick value and multipliers turn price moves into money, how margin and daily mark-to-market work, what happens at expiry, how the futures curve looks, and why losses can exceed margin.
practicalResult: Work out P/L, notional value, leverage and the margin-call price for 5 fictional contract specs in the futures contract calculator, doing at least two by hand first, then place and manage 5 paper trades on the practice index future with a stop on every one.
